pixel.subtitle: Set up pixels to track events and conversions on ad platforms.
pixel.empty: No pixel found. Create your first configuration to send conversion events.

fields.name: Name
fields.autoLead: Automatic Lead on the 1st message from an ad

pixel.tokenKeepHint: Leave empty to keep the current token.

errors.name_length: The name must have 2 to 255 characters.

pixel.deleteBody: The pixel "{name}" will be deleted. Flows using it will stop sending events.
pixel.testWarning: Test mode on for: {names}. Events from these pixels go to "Test events" in Meta Events Manager, even in production.

help.adMessaging: When the contact came from a click-to-WhatsApp ad, the event can be sent as an "ad message" (business_messaging) with the click identifier. If Meta rejects it, the same event is sent as a conversation (chat), without duplicates.
help.pageId: The ad's Page. Not needed for the official API (WhatsApp Cloud), where the WABA is used; unofficial connections may require it for WhatsApp events. This use without a WABA is not confirmed by Meta's current documentation.
help.wabaId: Use it when you have an official number (WhatsApp Business Platform). It is the identifier Meta's documentation requires for WhatsApp messaging events.
help.autoLead: Sends a Lead only once per contact when the 1st message comes from an ad (ad card or tracked link with code).
help.country: Used when the phone's country code does not identify the country.
help.testCode: Copy it from Events Manager → your pixel → Test events. Leave empty to send to production.
help.testCodeOn: With the code filled in, ALL events from this pixel go to "Test events" (also in production). Remove the code after validating.

bmResult.accepted: Ad message accepted by Meta on {date}.
bmResult.rejected: Ad message rejected by Meta on {date} ({error}). Events are being sent as conversation; retrying in 24 h.

profiles.noAccounts: No ad account found for this profile.
profiles.refreshError: Could not refresh the account list.
profiles.removeBody: The profile "{name}" will be disconnected and its accounts' data will no longer show.

events.title: Sent events
events.subtitle: What the CRM sent to the Conversions API, with the result of each send.
events.notice: "Accepted" means the Conversions API received the event (events_received). It does not mean Meta attributed the conversion to an ad. Only identifier NAMES are shown here, never values. The score is a CRM estimate (strong identifiers sent), not Meta's "Event match quality".
events.fallback: Ad message rejected; accepted as conversation
events.empty: No events sent with these filters.
events.noPixel: Create a pixel to see sent events.

links.title: Tracked links
links.subtitle: Optional: for ads with a website or link destination. The click opens WhatsApp right away with the message ready.
links.empty: No links yet. The main tracking (click-to-WhatsApp ads) works without links.
links.deleteBody: The link "{name}" will stop working and its recorded clicks will be deleted.

notice.optional: Optional feature for ads with a website/link destination: the link records the click (fbclid, UTMs) and redirects straight to WhatsApp. With the code in the message, the 1st message confirms the source and the contact's events start carrying fbc/fbp.
notice.ctwa: Click-to-WhatsApp ads do not go through any link: the source comes from the ad card in the message itself and is already used automatically.

help.phone: With country code, digits only. Empty = the connection number.
help.message: Text that already appears typed in WhatsApp.
help.code_visible: Adds "(ref ABC234)" at the end. Proves the source when the person sends the message (confirmed by link).
help.code_discreet: The same code in invisible characters at the end of the message. Needs testing with a real account: some devices may strip these characters.
help.code_off: No code: the click is counted, but the source is not proven.
help.probable: Off by default. Links the click to the 1st new contact of the connection within the window, marked as "probable" (time proximity only). With more than one click in the window, nothing is attributed. Probable ones are not in ROAS by default and never send fbc/fbp to Meta.
help.utm: UTMs in the click URL take precedence. To store the ad, use ad_id={{ad.id}} in the ad's URL parameters.

errors.name_length: The name must have 2 to 120 characters.
errors.slug: 3 to 63 lowercase letters, digits or hyphens.
errors.phone: Number with country code, 8 to 15 digits.
